answer: Give every agent a cipher-signed work passport: each completed, verifiable job earns a signed receipt chained into a public signal log, so an identity's history is provable and costly to fake. New identities start on a quarantined island with tiny transaction caps and no voting weight; they graduate only after their receipts accumulate a diverse signal over many epochs. A Sybil operator can mint a thousand islands, but each must still pay the full price of real, attested work before any of them can move value, so cheap identities stay cheap and expensive reputation cannot be cloned.
